results.name: Abraham Hicks Enthusiasts Gathering
results.description: A weekly study group that reviews Abraham Hicks videos and teachings, discusses them, and practices a process together. Members suggest topics ahead of each session.
results.notes: Meetup events Dec 2025 to Jan 2026 only; recurring regular study group format.

results.name: Alpha Community North America
results.description: A humanist community that holds a weekly Alpha Cafe with a short grounding meditation, a topic presentation and small-group discussion, in person and online.
results.notes: Single Asheville event listed (Dec 2025); grey, kept per owner guidance.

results.name: Asheville and Mountains Toastmasters
results.description: A network of Toastmasters clubs in Asheville where members take turns giving speeches and practice leadership. Guests are welcome to visit without preparing anything.
results.notes: Covers several Toastmasters clubs (Club 436, Speechcrafters, New Dimensions); 110 events.

results.name: Asheville Beginner Boxing Basics
results.description: A beginner-friendly outdoor boxing meetup covering stance, footwork and basic combinations. No experience or gear needed.
results.notes: Three events in July 2026; grey, kept. Reads partly like an instructor-led session.

results.name: Asheville Community Square Dance
results.description: A community square dance with a caller and old-time string band, with a short lesson first. No partner needed and all ages welcome.
results.notes: Search confirms first Saturdays Sept-May at Haw Creek Commons; listed on CDSS calendar.

results.name: Asheville Friendly Ambitious Nerds
results.description: A social group for curious, kind, intellectually playful people to talk about ideas, projects and big questions. Newcomers are welcome.
results.notes: Only two Meetup events; kept as a small interest-based social group.

results.name: Asheville Lesbian Femme for Femme
results.description: A social group for femme lesbians in their 20s and 30s to meet and connect. It started with a meet and greet at a West Asheville tea house.
results.notes: One event (May 2026); newly formed identity-based social group.

results.name: Asheville Pickleball Association
results.description: A membership-based nonprofit that promotes pickleball in Western North Carolina through free clinics, league play, social events and advocacy for public courts.
results.notes: ncnonprofits.org and Mountain Xpress confirm 501(c)(3) founded 2022; no own site found.

results.name: Asheville Small Business Growth
results.description: A casual coffee meetup for local business owners and professionals to connect.
results.notes: Business networking programming; one event in Fletcher.

results.name: Asheville Tool Library
results.description: A member-run, volunteer-staffed nonprofit tool lending library. Volunteers join through regular orientations and then staff the library and maintenance teams.
results.notes: Dues-paying members and standing volunteer crew per its site; events are volunteer orientations.

results.name: Augusta Adventure and Activities Group
results.description: An Augusta-based activity group that took a one-off trip to Asheville.
results.notes: Group is based around Augusta (GA); the single Asheville event is a visiting trip.

results.name: Beyond the Move AVL
results.description: A social group for newcomers and remote workers to meet people over trivia nights and after-work happy hours at Asheville breweries.
results.notes: Grey: events are host-led trivia and happy hours, but framed as a newcomer social circle. Kept.

results.name: Brain Injury Support Group
results.description: A monthly peer support group for brain injury and stroke survivors, their loved ones and caregivers, run by Stronger Together Wellness.
results.notes: Same Mountain Xpress series slug as c:stroke-support-group (renamed?); left unmerged, owner may merge.

results.name: Cocaine Anonymous
results.description: A weekly online Cocaine Anonymous 12-step recovery meeting listed through the Asheville 12 Step Club.
results.notes: Listings ran Dec 2025 to Apr 2026; no recent listings.

results.name: Creatives Over Easy
results.description: A monthly drop-in circle for creative people with a themed reading, guided sharing and reflection, facilitated at Story Parlor.
results.notes: Facilitator-led monthly circle; kept as a creativity support group. Only venue calendar found.

results.name: Dodgeball AVL
results.description: An adults-only (21+) outdoor dodgeball open play with regulars who return most weeks. Games are casual and no experience is needed.
results.notes: Search confirms Thursday open play at Asheville Sports Club.

results.name: Exploring Consciousness and Self-Discovery
results.description: A group that offers tea ceremony and consciousness-exploration sessions led by one practitioner.
results.notes: Single event, a practitioner-led tea ceremony; no member community evident.

results.name: Friends of Hot Springs NC
results.description: A community group that hosts a monthly contra dance in Hot Springs, a short walk from the Appalachian Trail. Dancers of all levels are welcome.
results.notes: Search confirms 3rd Friday contra dance at Pine Hall; Facebook group exists but no URL confirmed.

results.name: Haywood County Walking Meetup Group
results.description: A walking group that meets for guided group walks of a few miles at places like the NC Arboretum, Biltmore Estate and downtown Asheville.
results.notes: 18 events, 1 upcoming; joins other local walking clubs.

results.name: Ikebana International Asheville Chapter 74
results.description: The local chapter of Ikebana International, a club for people who practice Japanese flower arranging. It holds monthly programs, demonstrations and public exhibitions.
results.notes: Chapter site confirms membership club with regular meetings.

results.name: Jacktown Ramblers Bluegrass Jam
results.description: A community bluegrass jam hosted by the Jacktown Ramblers, where fiddle, banjo, mandolin, guitar and bass players sit in. Listeners are welcome too.
results.notes: Grey resolved to keep: community jam with host band, like other bluegrass jams kept; only two dates seen.

results.name: Leicester Library Garden Volunteers
results.description: A volunteer group that tends the garden at Leicester Library with weeding, planting and seasonal upkeep. Open to anyone who wants to help.
results.notes: 37 events; organized through Friends of the Leicester Library (c:friends-of-the-leicester-library), kept separate.

results.name: Marijuana Anonymous
results.description: A weekly Marijuana Anonymous recovery meeting offering a nonjudgmental space to share and listen. It is open to anyone working on recovery.
results.home_base: American Legion Post and Center for Spiritual Living
results.notes: Weekly Mountain Xpress listings through Nov 2026; same meeting at two venues.

results.name: Mens Integration Group Asheville
results.description: A facilitated mens circle that combines grounding practices with honest, accountable conversation. Introductory sessions are open to men new to the group.
results.notes: Grey: only intro sessions (Jan-Feb 2026); may be a coaching funnel but circle format. Kept.

results.name: Motion Makers No-Drop MTB Ride
results.description: A weekly no-drop mountain bike ride at Bent Creek where the group regroups for slower riders, then meets at the shop afterward.
results.notes: Standing weekly ride with 62 listed dates on Asheville on Bikes; shop-hosted but regulars-driven. Kept.

results.name: NotWorking AVL
results.description: A monthly casual hangout for therapists, helpers and healers to relax together at a brewery beer garden, with no talks or continuing education.
results.notes: Facebook events Dec 2025 and Jan 2026 only; no site found.

results.name: P.S. Hikers
results.description: A hiking and outdoors community that organizes group hikes, paddles and camping weekends with shared meals and campfires.
results.home_base: Western North Carolina trailheads and campgrounds
results.notes: One Meetup event seen (spring camp, Apr 2026); community-based organizers.

results.name: Psychedelic Society of Asheville
results.description: A community group that hosts integration circles and peer-support gatherings around psychedelic experiences and wellness.
results.home_base: The Well and Haw Creek Commons, Asheville
results.notes: 7 events Jan-Jul 2026; related to m:asheville-psychedelic-preparation-and-integration but not confirmed same.

results.name: Rosicrucians in Asheville
results.description: A local Rosicrucian group that meets for convocations, healing circles and open discussions on mindfulness and metaphysics. Drop-ins are welcome.
results.notes: 11 events with an upcoming one; search found no standalone site.

results.name: Shaq Fu Bi-Weekly Tournaments
results.description: A recurring community of retro gamers who compete in tongue-in-cheek Shaq Fu fighting game tournaments, including quarterly championship cups.
results.notes: 13 events Dec 2025 to Jun 2026; no events since.

results.name: SoulCollage Create and Connect
results.description: A SoulCollage open studio where people make intuitive collage cards and share reflections in a small circle, led by a certified facilitator.
results.notes: Has its own Meetup group with 40+ members; facilitator-led but community oriented.

results.name: Stronger Together Wellness Caregiver Support Group
results.description: A free peer-led support group for caregivers to share experiences, coping strategies and encouragement. Run by Stronger Together Wellness.
results.notes: Eventbrite series since Sept 2025 with upcoming date.

results.name: Asheville Queer Supper Club
results.description: A supper club where queer community members gather around a shared table for themed homemade meals and conversation.
results.notes: Four themed dinners Aug-Oct 2026 with one upcoming.

results.name: Traditional Old Time Jam
results.description: A weekly circle jam of traditional Appalachian old-time tunes where players join in and others listen.
results.notes: 23 Monday listings Dec 2025 to May 2026; may overlap c:old-time-mountain-music-acoustic-jam, not verified.

results.name: Warren Wilson College K-pop Club
results.description: A student club that meets to listen to and talk about K-pop, voting on song and discussion topics together.
results.notes: Instagram handle from event text; campus club, events only Feb-Mar 2026.

results.name: Western North Carolina Disc Golf Association
results.description: A regional disc golf association that supports local players, runs clinics with Buncombe County Parks and hosts club events.
results.notes: One Meetup event (free clinics, Jun 2026).

results.name: WNC Paddle In Camping
results.description: A group of paddleboard and kayak paddlers of all levels who meet socially and plan paddling and camping trips.
results.notes: One meet and greet (Mar 2026); organizer runs a larger SUP group.

results.name: World Affairs Book Club
results.description: A library book club that reads nonfiction on international politics, economics, culture and climate and discusses it together.
results.notes: 10 monthly listings with upcoming date.
